caption: The drawing features a small, square-shaped, highly detailed segment of textile or fabric located roughly in the center of an otherwise blank, off-white background. Within the square, there are at least four distinct textured sections: one in the upper left that appears dark (black or dark gray) with a woven pattern, another below it towards the left that is a light tan color with a coarse burlap-like texture, a third on the right that is beige with a tightly packed, cracked or pebble-like pattern, and a fourth segment in the lower right that is turquoise or blue, featuring a bumpy, irregular surface. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to suggest depth and material differences between these colored sections. No additional objects or decorative elements are present outside the central colored square.
title: Hooked Rug (Detail)
